meta.title: fix(tabs): resolve memory leak caused by animation transitions
meta.body_summary: Fix nz-tabset memory leak by separating animation transitions and adding a completion handler to prevent detached DOM elements from accumulating during tab destruction.

perf_labels.notes: Copilot attempted to fix nz-tabset memory leak by separating animation transitions, but maintainer pointed out it would break original animation behavior; after restoring behavior, PR was closed without merge.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 186 changed lines, this is a small-to-medium edit concentrated in animation logic and a test file. It fits a targeted bug fix for a memory leak, but the outcome (closed without merge) suggests maintainer concerns about preserving animation behavior outweighed the fix.

review_details.concern_detail: HyperLife1119 noted that separating animation transitions would destroy the original animation behavior, which required absolute positioning during leave to remove from document flow and smoothly transition opacity.
review_details.performance_claim: Eliminates memory leak from detached DOM elements in nz-tabset during tab switching, with stable memory usage after fix.
review_details.rejection_signals: Maintainer raised that the fix would break original animation behavior; after Copilot restored original behavior, PR was closed without merge.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Fixing a memory leak while preserving complex Angular animation behavior requires deep understanding of animation lifecycle; Copilot initially broke the animation, then restored it but PR not merged.

detection_detail.code_reading: HyperLife1119 manually examined the animation change and identified that the separation of '*' => leave' and ':leave' transitions would remove absolute positioning needed during tab leave animation, breaking visual behavior.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: PR body includes StackBlitz repro and manual test steps for the memory leak, but no verification was done by reviewer; the concern was solely about animation impact.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: After maintainer pointed out the animation breakage, Copilot restored the original combined transition, but the PR was still closed without merge, indicating the fix was not accepted.

core_change_summary.description: Modified tabSwitchMotion animation in components/core/animation/tabs.ts to initially separate '* => leave' and ':leave' transitions, then reverted to combined transition while keeping an animation completion handler in tab-body.component.ts to help cleanup. A memory leak test spec was added.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Test file added to verify no detached DOM accumulation; most line changes are in the new test file (145 lines).
change_trajectory: Initial commit: separated animation transitions for leave states and added animation completion handler.
After maintainer commented that this would break original animation behavior, Copilot restored the original combined transition while retaining the handler.

review_signals.summary: Preview link will be available after CI passes.
All modified lines are covered by tests; patch coverage unchanged at 92.11%.
Questioned whether separating transitions would destroy the intended leave animation behavior (absolute positioning then opacity fade).
review_signals.action_taken: Copilot restored the original combined transition and confirmed in reply.

review_signals.summary: Acknowledged the concern and committed the fix to restore original animation behavior while keeping the leak prevention handler.

collaboration_trajectory: Copilot opened PR with memory leak fix linked to issue #9095.
No formal review; bot comments on preview and coverage.
After ~6.7 days, maintainer HyperLife1119 left a comment pointing out the animation behavior would be broken.
Copilot responded within minutes, committing a fix to restore original combined transition.
PR was closed by HyperLife1119 shortly after without merge.
